finding.claim: Checkout does not check whether a leading directory component of a tree path is a symlink. A malicious repository can plant a symlink and then have later entries written through it to an arbitrary location outside the work tree. This is the CVE-2021-21300 and CVE-2019-1387 class. Two routes get a symlink and a same-prefix path into one checkout. (1) Duplicate or conflicting entries: a tree has a symlink entry 'a' pointing to an absolute path or '..', plus a tree 'a' containing 'evil'. The duplicate-entry check at objects.py:1638 sits in the fsck-style check, not in parsing or checkout. (2) Case collisions on case-insensitive filesystems: a symlink 'a' and a directory 'A/evil'. validate_path only rejects '.git', '.', '..' and NTFS or HFS dotgit spellings, and does not look at symlink targets or earlier components. This is a probable finding from a static read. I did not run a PoC, and I have not confirmed that the pack-receive path accepts such a tree.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled repository content (tree entries and symlink blob target) fetched by clone or fetch and then checked out. The victim runs porcelain clone or checkout, or calls build_index_from_tree or update_working_tree.
finding.sink: os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(full_path)) and build_file_from_blob() open(target_path,'wb') / os.chmod. Both follow the planted symlink, so the write, and any chmod, lands outside the work tree.

trace.note: iter_tree_contents yields attacker-supplied entries, including a symlink entry and a path under the same name
validate_path only validates each element name against .git, dot and NTFS/HFS rules; it does not check symlinks or earlier components
_tree_to_fs_path does a plain os.path.join(root, path) with no realpath or commonpath containment
os.path.exists and os.makedirs on dirname follow the symlink, so a symlinked directory counts as existing
symlink entry is created with the attacker's target (absolute or ..) unmodified
open(target_path,'wb') writes the blob through the symlinked parent directory. Only the final component is lstat-checked, at 1904

finding.guards_checked: validate_path and validate_path_element_* (name-based only); the final-component symlink check at index.py:1904 (does not cover parent components); the _check_parent_dirs helper near index.py:2380 (only checks for non-directory parents, and isdir follows symlinks); the update_working_tree conflict checks (they only handle file-becoming-directory cases); the Tree duplicate check at objects.py:1638 (not applied at checkout). A grep for islink, realpath and commonpath in index.py found no containment check on parent components.
